source.name: KMA ASOS Daily Weather API
source.note: These are launch planning notes. Production should calculate exact same-period previous-year weather with the KMA ASOS API once an API key is configured.

June.range: warm, increasingly humid, rain risk rising
June.outdoorAdvice: For outdoor plazas, pop-up queues, and palace routes, check same-day rain and UV before leaving.

June.range: warm coastal weather, humidity and evening crowd risk
June.outdoorAdvice: For stadium and waterfront events, plan post-event transit and allow time for crowds near beaches and stations.

June.range: regional variation; city-specific weather check required
June.outdoorAdvice: Use this as a pre-trip reminder, then confirm local forecasts and official venue notices.
